templates.pattern: Six persons [P1],[P2],[P3],[P4],[P5],[P6] sit in a row facing north. [P1] is 3rd from left. [P4] is to the immediate right of [P1]. [P6] is at the rightmost end. [P2] is between [P4] and [P6]. [P3] is at leftmost end. Who is at 2nd position from left?
templates.explanation: Order: [P3]-?-[P1]-[P4]-[P2]-[P6]. Position 2 = [P5]

templates.pattern: Seven people [P1] to [P7] sit in a circle facing centre. [P1] is 2nd to the right of [P4]. [P3] is 3rd to the left of [P7]. [P2] is between [P1] and [P3]. [P5] is to the immediate left of [P4]. How many persons are between [P5] and [P7] going clockwise?
templates.explanation: Circular arrangement of 7. Solving positions: between [P5] and [P7] clockwise = 2 persons

templates.pattern: Eight persons sit in two parallel rows of 4 each. [P1],[P2],[P3],[P4] face south (Row 1). [P5],[P6],[P7],[P8] face north (Row 2). [P2] faces [P6]. [P4] is at rightmost of row 1. [P8] is at leftmost of row 2. [P3] is 2nd from left in row 1. [P7] faces [P3]. Who faces [P1]?
templates.explanation: Row1: [P1]-[P3]-[P2]-[P4]. Row2 mirror: [P5]-[P7]-[P6]-[P8] reversed → [P8]-[P6]-[P7]-[P5]. [P1] faces [P5]

templates.pattern: Five persons [P1],[P2],[P3],[P4],[P5] sit in a circle. All face outward. [P1] is 2nd to left of [P3]. [P4] is to the immediate right of [P3]. [P5] is to the immediate left of [P1]. Who is seated between [P2] and [P4]?
templates.explanation: Circle order: [P5]-[P1]-[P2]-[P3]-[P4]. Between [P2] and [P4] is [P3]

templates.pattern: In a row of [N] persons, [P1] is [A]th from left. [P2] is [B]th from right. If [C] persons sit between them and [P1] is to the left of [P2], find total persons in the row.
templates.explanation: Total = Left position + Right position + persons between = [A]+[B]+[C]

templates.pattern: Six people [P1],[P2],[P3],[P4],[P5],[P6] sit around a circular table facing inward. [P1] sits 3 places to the right of [P5]. [P3] is opposite [P2]. [P4] is to the immediate right of [P1]. [P6] is opposite [P4]. Who is opposite [P1]?
templates.explanation: In a 6-person circle, [P1] opposite = [P2] (derived from given constraints)

templates.pattern: In a row of [N] people, [P1] is [A]th from left and [P2] is [B]th from left. [P3] is exactly midway between [P1] and [P2]. [P4] is [K] places right of [P3]. What is [P4]'s position from right?
templates.explanation: [P3] position = (A+B)/2. [P4] position from left = (A+B)/2 + K. From right = N - that + 1

templates.pattern: Eight persons [P1]-[P8] sit in a circle facing the centre. [P1] is 3rd to right of [P5]. [P3] is 2nd to left of [P1]. [P7] is between [P5] and [P3]. [P2] is opposite [P7]. [P4] is to immediate right of [P8]. How many persons are between [P2] and [P6] in clockwise direction?
templates.explanation: After solving circular arrangement of 8, between [P2] and [P6] clockwise = 3 persons

templates.pattern: Seven persons [P1]-[P7] sit in a row. [P4] is 4th from right. [P2] is 3rd from left. [P6] is between [P4] and [P7]. [P7] is at rightmost end. [P1] is between [P2] and [P4]. [P5] is at leftmost end. What is [P3]'s position from left?
templates.explanation: Order: [P5]-[P3]-[P2]-[P1]-[P4]-[P6]-[P7]. [P3] is at position 2 from left

templates.pattern: Ten students sit in a row. [P1] is [A]th from left. [P2] is [B]th from right. [P3] is exactly between them. [P3] is [C]th from left. How many students are to the right of [P2]?
templates.explanation: Right of [P2] = B-1 = [B]-1

templates.pattern: Six persons [P1]-[P6] sit around a circular table, alternating male-female. [P1] (male) is to the immediate left of [P2] (female). [P3] (male) is 2nd to right of [P2]. [P5] (female) is opposite [P3]. Who is to the immediate right of [P5]?
templates.explanation: Circular arrangement: [P1]-[P2]-[P3]-[P4]-[P5]-[P6]. Immediate right of [P5] = [P4]

templates.pattern: In a row of [N] students, [P1] ranks [A]th from front and [B]th from back. [P2] is [K] ranks ahead of [P1]. What is [P2]'s rank from back?
templates.explanation: [P2] is K ahead of [P1]. [P2] rank from front = A-K. From back = N-(A-K)+1 = B+K = [B]+[K]

templates.pattern: Nine persons [P1]-[P9] sit in 3 rows of 3. Row1 faces Row2, Row2 faces Row3. [P1],[P2],[P3] in Row1. [P4],[P5],[P6] in Row2. [P7],[P8],[P9] in Row3. [P1] faces [P4], [P4] faces [P7]. [P2] is to right of [P1]. [P5] is to left of [P4]. Who faces [P2]?
templates.explanation: Row1: [P1]-[P2]-[P3]. Row2 (facing): [P4]-[P6]-[P5] → [P2] faces [P6]

templates.pattern: Eight persons [P1]-[P8] sit in a circle. [P1] faces outward, all others face inward. [P2] is to the immediate right of [P1]. [P3] is 3rd to left of [P2]. [P4] is opposite [P3]. [P5] is between [P2] and [P4]. Who is to the immediate left of [P1]?
templates.explanation: Solving arrangement: [P1] faces outward so left/right are reversed. Immediate left of [P1] = [P8]

templates.pattern: In a row of [N] persons, [P1] is [A]th from left. [P2] is [B]th from right. [P1] is to the left of [P2]. If they both move [K] places towards each other, how many persons are between them now?
templates.explanation: Original gap = N-A-B. After both move K towards each other, gap reduces by 2K. Between = N-A-B-2K-1

templates.pattern: Five people [P1],[P2],[P3],[P4],[P5] sit in a row. [P1] is not adjacent to [P3] or [P5]. [P2] is at one end. [P4] is to the immediate right of [P2]. [P5] is between [P3] and [P1]. Who sits at the other end?
templates.explanation: Order: [P2]-[P4]-[P3]-[P5]-[P1]. Other end = [P1]

templates.pattern: In a row of [N] people, [P1] is at position [A] from left. [P2] is at position [B] from right. Both shift [K] places to the right. What are their new positions from left?
templates.explanation: [P1] new position from left = A+K = [A]+[K]. [P2] new from left = (N-B+1)+K

templates.pattern: Six persons sit around a hexagonal table. One person on each side. [P1] faces [P4]. [P2] is to the immediate right of [P1]. [P3] is between [P4] and [P5] (going right from [P4]). [P6] is to the immediate right of [P3]. Who is to the immediate left of [P2]?
templates.explanation: Arrangement: [P1]-[P2]-[P6]-[P3]-[P4]-[P5]. Immediate left of [P2] = [P1]

templates.pattern: In a group of [N] students, [P1] is [A]th from front in a column. [P2] is [B]th from front. [P2] is exactly [C] places behind [P3]. What is [P3]'s position from the back?
templates.explanation: [P3] from front = B-C. From back = N-(B-C)+1 = [N]-([B]-[C])+1

templates.pattern: Five persons [P1]-[P5] sit in a row facing east. After re-arrangement: [P1] and [P3] swap, [P2] and [P4] swap. Originally [P3] was at position [A] and [P2] was at position [B]. Now what is [P1]'s position from right?
templates.explanation: After swap [P1] goes to [P3]'s original position [A] from left. From right = N-A+1 = [N]-[A]+1

templates.pattern: Seven people [P1]-[P7] sit in a circle facing inward. [P1] is 3rd to right of [P6]. [P2] is immediate right of [P1]. [P4] is 2nd to left of [P5]. [P3] is between [P7] and [P2] going clockwise. How many sit between [P4] and [P6] anticlockwise?
templates.explanation: Solving 7-person circular arrangement, between [P4] and [P6] anticlockwise = 2 persons

templates.pattern: In a row of [N] persons, [P1] and [P2] are [D] places apart. [P1] is at position [A] from left. If [P2] is to the right of [P1], what is [P2]'s rank from right?
templates.explanation: [P2] from left = A+D. From right = N-(A+D)+1 = [N]-([A]+[D])+1

templates.pattern: Ten people sit in a row. [P1] is [A]th from left. [P2] is [B]th from right. If [P1] moves [K] places right and [P2] moves [K] places left, do they now occupy the same position? Total persons = [N].
templates.explanation: [P1] new pos = A+K = [A+K]. [P2] new pos from left = N-B+1-K = [N-B+1-K]. Check if equal.

templates.pattern: Eight students sit in two rows of 4 facing each other. Row A faces south, Row B faces north. [P1] (Row A) is 3rd from left. [P5] (Row B) faces [P1]. [P2] is to immediate left of [P1] in Row A. [P3] is to immediate right of [P5] in Row B. [P4] is opposite [P3]. Which row A person is at the leftmost position?
templates.explanation: Row A: [P4]-[P2]-[P1]-[P6]. Leftmost of Row A = [P4]

templates.pattern: In a row of [N] persons, [P1] is [A]th from left, [P2] is [B]th from left. They interchange with [P3] (middle person). After interchange, [P1] is [C]th from right. What was [P2]'s original distance from [P1]?
templates.explanation: Original distance = |B-A| = |[B]-[A]|
